name: A Helping Hand
source:
Anna is a highly ambitious, but overworked college student. 

Lately her every waking moment has been focused on studying for her finals. 

We meet her on a seemingly ordinary afternoon, a determined Anna is working tirelessly as usual. 

When she is suddenly interrupted, by a prominent figure at the school.......
